item.text: The handler currently calls `web.input()` with defaults and immediately unflattens it; that allows query parameters into body submissions, and the shared `unflatten` helper refuses later writes to an already populated key. I’m updating the handler to select either parsed body fields or query fields, and adjusting unflattening so later assignments win.

Also updated unflattening so later assignments take precedence and nested values can replace scalar parents.
